title: Graduate Civil/Structural Engineer
content_text:
Graduate Civil/Structural Engineer
J+P Building Solutions  ·  Melbourne, VIC  ·  Full-time
Join a specialist structural engineering consultancy that is actively delivering some of Melbourne's most prestigious architectural builds.
J+P Building Solutions is currently delivering some of Melbourne’s most striking architectural builds — bespoke, design-led homes and commercial developments that demand real engineering creativity and carry genuine prestige. We work in close partnership with the city’s most reputable architects and builders, and as a graduate joining our team, you’ll be part of that work from the start.
You’ll be building a high-profile portfolio — the kind that takes most engineers years to accumulate — while being supported every step of the way by a close-knit team of experienced engineers who take mentorship seriously.
What you’ll be working on
Our current pipeline spans some of Melbourne’s most architecturally significant residential builds — including high-end custom homes and boutique multi-storey residential developments — alongside a varied mix of commercial work including industrial facilities, retail and mixed-use projects. It’s a broad, stimulating body of work that offers rare structural variety this early in a career.
Beyond the project mix, you’ll be gaining access to advanced, highly specialised structural design knowledge — developed over decades of working on technically demanding, design-led projects alongside the best in the industry.
Day to day, you’ll be
•       Working alongside our experienced engineering team on structural and civil design and documentation
•       Building a portfolio you’ll be proud to show for the rest of your career
What we’re looking for
•       A Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering (recently completed)
•       High attention to detail and strong analytical skills — an ability to think carefully through structural problems and produce precise, considered work
•       Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-first attitude
•       A genuine eagerness to learn; familiarity with AutoCAD and popular structural analysis software (such as SpaceGass) is expected, while experience with Revit is a plus — above all, we value curiosity and drive
•       Full working rights in Australia
What’s in it for you
•       Immediate involvement in some of Melbourne’s most architecturally significant current builds — rare exposure at graduate level
•       A varied commercial and residential project mix that broadens your structural experience from early on
•       Access to specialised design knowledge and mentorship from a team of experienced engineers, including a Chartered Professional Engineer with 20+ years in the industry
•       A supportive, people-first culture where growth is taken seriously and asking questions is always encouraged
•       A clear pathway toward chartered status with team support every step of the way
•       Flexible working arrangements, including flexible hours and a hybrid attendance model
•       Competitive salary commensurate with experience
To apply
Send your CV and a brief cover letter to admin@jpbs.com.au with the subject line ‘Graduate Engineer Application’. We look forward to hearing from you.
